name: Katie Hunter
summary: At the Eastvale Logging Camp stables, Katie Hunter tends horses for Stormwind and trusted Alliance champions. She works with Randal Hunter to keep travelers and soldiers mounted for the kingdom’s roads.

sections.title: Stables of Eastvale
sections.body: Katie Hunter tends the horses at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. While lumberjacks cut timber for Stormwind’s reconstruction, she raises dependable pintos, mares, and swift steeds for riders. Her horses carry people along the kingdom’s roads and the dangerous routes of southern Azeroth.

faq.answer: Katie Hunter breeds and sells horses for the Kingdom of Stormwind at the Eastvale Logging Camp stables in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where can I find Katie Hunter?
faq.answer: You can find Katie in the northern part of the Eastvale Logging Camp, tending the corral and stables near Randal Hunter, a riding trainer, in eastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Can non-humans buy horses from her?
faq.answer: Yes. Non-human buyers need exalted standing with the Kingdom of Stormwind. Human adventurers can buy her horses without special standing.
Katie sells standard riding horses, including pinto, brown, and chestnut varieties, as well as swift, armored steeds such as the Swift Palomino, Swift Brown Steed, and Swift White Steed.

angles.text: As a human, you can buy a classic Stormwind horse from Katie once you have mastered the basics of horsemanship.
As an allied race, you can earn the privilege of riding Katie’s prized steeds into battle by gaining high standing and respect with Stormwind’s court.
